published.source: Second race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16, after dev notes post 8): Undead; verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 949.2 as Human on the same sim)

summary: Deep Shadow. Its Discipline points take Twin Disciplines, Silent Resolve (threat), Mental Strength and Inner Focus. Its 3 Holy points take Twilight Focus for pushback protection.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadowform at -4.5s, Shadowguard (Troll) at -3s, Mind Blast at -1.5s to land at the pull, then the on-use trinket and Major Spellblasting Potion at -0.1s
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 10% mana. Racials and trinkets on cooldown.
Shadow Word: Pain when it is down, with 9s or more left
Devouring Plague when it is down and off its 24s cooldown, with 12s or more left
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown. Then Mind Blast on cooldown, with Inner Focus right before it.
Shadowguard (Troll) again once its charges are used, with 60s or more left and 40% mana or more
Mind Flay as filler. It's cut after the second tick when Shadow Word: Pain or Devouring Plague drops, never for Mind Blast.
Wand from 10% to 20% mana with 60s or more left, or when nothing else can be cast. Shadow never gets that low.
caveats: Only the 2-piece set bonus is active. The Raiments 4-piece and 5-piece aren't measured with Devouring Plague's 24s cooldown.
Assumed: Shadow Weaving applies to the priest's own Shadow damage. In Forever, periodic spells crit per tick.
Mind Flay rolls to hit once per cast and isn't hasted. Shadow Word: Death's backlash is ignored.
Left out: Brilliant Wizard Oil (+12.5) and Elixir of Sages (+13.9).
Improved Mind Flay makes each tick do 20% more than the last. Dark Inspiration's Spirit goes to the priest only.
Mana barely matters. It takes about 13 min to run out.
